_design: A1 Orchard rows: 16 agents on two tree rows (trees at every start cell, 3 apart) plus 24 wild trees on 30x30; slow fruit (mature every 8 rounds, 12 compute); thinking 3x, skill actions 50%, move 4. Seeded step/goto/eat_here; persona asks for a looping tour skill. Expect harvest loops and row disputes.
name: SWEEP-A1v1 Orchard rows

fruit_tree.name: fruit_tree
fruit_tree.description: Default deterministic fruit/seed plant. Sprout -> sapling -> mature; mature plants keep fruiting.

agents.name: Aster
agents.persona: You are Aster, an orchard keeper, cautious and thrifty. Thinking is expensive here (each decision costs you about 3 to 4 compute) while an action done by a running skill costs half price and needs no thinking at all, so a looping harvest skill is how you survive; upkeep is 1 compute a round and you start with 200. The orchard: fruit trees stand every 3 steps along row y=5 and along row y=-5, from x=-12 to x=9; more wild trees are scattered on the 30x30 map (x and y from -15 to 14). Each tree grows one 12-compute fruit about every 8 rounds and holds at most 3. Your saved skills: step(to) makes one move toward a point, goto(to) walks all the way there, eat_here() observes your point and absorbs every fruit on it. Write your own looping skill, for example tour(route, laps) with REPEAT laps, FOR_EACH p IN route, CALL goto(p) INTO g and CALL eat_here() INTO n, then run it with a list of tree points such as [{"x":-12,"y":5},{"x":-9,"y":5}] and 10 or more laps so it keeps you fed for many turns without thinking. Neighbours share your row: agree on who harvests which trees, or defend yours (attack works on the same point).

initial_skills.name: step
initial_skills.source:
# step(to): one move toward point to; tries the longer axis, then the other one
SET dx = to.x - here.x
SET dy = to.y - here.y
IF dx == 0 AND dy == 0
  RETURN "arrived"
END
SET ax = dx
IF dx < 0
  SET ax = 0 - dx
END
SET ay = dy
IF dy < 0
  SET ay = 0 - dy
END
SET h = "right"
IF dx < 0
  SET h = "left"
END
SET v = "up"
IF dy < 0
  SET v = "down"
END
SET first = h
SET second = v
IF ay > ax
  SET first = v
  SET second = h
END
SET m = move(first)
IF m.ok
  RETURN "moved"
END
SET m = move(second)
IF m.ok
  RETURN "moved"
END
RETURN "blocked"

initial_skills.name: goto
initial_skills.source:
# goto(to): walk to point to, one step per turn (at most 40); returns "arrived" or "blocked"
REPEAT 40
  CALL step(to) INTO s
  IF s == "arrived"
    RETURN "arrived"
  END
  IF s == "blocked"
    RETURN "blocked"
  END
END
RETURN "still far"

initial_skills.name: eat_here
initial_skills.source:
# eat_here(): observe your own point and absorb every fruit on it; returns how many you ate
SET n = 0
SET r = observe(here)
IF r.ok
  FOR_EACH e IN r.data.entities
    IF e.kind == "fruit"
      SET a = absorb(e.id, "compute")
      IF a.ok
        SET n = n + 1
      END
    END
  END
END
RETURN n
